description: Takes a pitch voltage and puts it out again two octaves down, one down, one up and two up

inputs.text: The pitch voltage to be transposed, in as many polyphonic channels as the cable carries

outputs.text: Carries the input pitch with 2V taken off, two octaves down
Carries the input pitch with 1V taken off, one octave down
Carries the input pitch with 1V added, one octave up
Carries the input pitch with 2V added, two octaves up

notes: the transposed voltage is not checked against any audible range, so it can fall below or rise above anything a VCO will play
with nothing patched to the input the four outputs are not written at all and hold whatever they last carried
